about: The Workbench icons of the HexAHop drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's data/hex-a-hop.png at 48x48. HexAHop-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, HexAHop.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's HexAHop.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licences; Folder.info for data.
